mentions.name: Loomavi
mentions.description: Loomavi decodes the pattern underneath what the user is feeling and delivers the insight as a personal letter, drawing on psychology and philosophy.
mentions.problem: The builder kept looking for something like it and could not find it anywhere, so built it themselves.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built Loomavi. It decodes the pattern underneath 
what you are feeling and gives you the insight as 
a personal letter using psychology and philosophy.
